document.title: Form PF.23/M — Change of Contact Information

chunks.part: Form PF.23/M — Change of Contact Information
chunks.heading: What is Form PF.23/M used for, and when should it NOT be used?
chunks.text: Form PF.23/M is used to update contact information (mailing address, phone number, email, and emergency contact). If you are on the two-track system, this form should NOT be used to report a change of country of residence — use form PENS.E/11 instead.

chunks.part: Form PF.23/M — Change of Contact Information
chunks.heading: What information is required in Sections 1 through 3?
chunks.text: Section 1 (Retiree or beneficiary information) requires UID, pension number, retirement number, and full name. Section 2 (Contact information) requires the mailing address, phone number and email. Section 3 (Emergency contact) requires the emergency contact's full name, mailing address, phone number, relationship, and email.

chunks.part: Form PF.23/M — Change of Contact Information
chunks.heading: What do I acknowledge and confirm by signing Section 4?
chunks.text: You confirm that the information provided is true and correct, that you have read the form's instructions, and that you have enclosed any other required documents listed in the instructions.
